items.title: Freeport McMoRan (FCX) Stock May Be Pricey After Record Copper Rally
items.summary: Freeport-McMoRan stock has pushed to fresh highs in a strong copper rally, while the valuation checks present a mixed picture. The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate points to a sizeable discount, whereas market multiples suggest a more expensive profile. For investors, the question is how to weigh a low broad value score against that DCF signal after such a strong run.
